## Rule

Input foreground is color 5 on a 10x10 active grid. Output recolors each
color-5 connected component to color 2 iff its component area is exactly 6;
all other color-5 cells become color 1. Background remains color 0.

## Algorithm sketch

Compact ONNX approach:
- Slice channel 5 over the 10x10 active grid.
- Detect size-6 components with six signed bounding-box Conv kernels:
  a h x w box contributes +1 inside the box and -8 on the expanded boundary;
  `Equal(score, 6)` means exactly six foreground cells in the box and no
  foreground in the generic boundary.
- MaxPool each anchor map over its box size, intersect the rectangle mask with
  the original foreground, and emit BOOL channels `[bg, size!=6, size==6]`
  padded back to 10 output channels and 30x30 spatial size.
- Two exact signed-kernel fallback detectors cover the one visible case where
  nearby disconnected components sit in the generic expanded boundary but are
  not adjacent to the size-6 component.
